name: minimal-luxury
vibe: A minimalist-luxury keynote film with vast negative space and quiet, tasteful motion. A warm ivory ground, one slowly drifting soft accent glow, a slow soft light sweep, a whisper of fine grain and a barely-there vignette flow unbroken across every cut. A single elegant serif headline with fine letter-spacing, thin hairline rules, wide-tracked small-cap labels, a thin-bordered screenshot frame with generous margin, and a minimal outline-button CTA. One restrained accent — a refined gold by default — recolors the whole film: the accent hairlines, the highlight word, the CTA outline and the ambient glow, not just the text. Understated, premium — a fashion / watch-brand feel. Portrait-native 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Rendered as a native GSAP + canvas composition. Best for premium brands, fashion, watches, high-end SaaS, product launches and anything that should feel elegant, calm and expensive.
